depth_definition.inspected: Exact captured source received focused semantic/structural inspection; not a claim that every line/branch/value was audited.
depth_definition.family-supported: Individual bytes not read; bounded facts come from named inspected representative, producer or consumer. No individual assertion/render/provenance implied.
depth_definition.metadata-only: Only assigned-tree identity and external boundary references; no claimed semantic understanding of the file.

execution_status: No product tests, builds, typechecks, generation, app rendering, terminal sessions or remote mutations executed.

families.purpose: Terminal package manifest, ownership and build configuration
families.source_implications: Explicit run/config/runtime/context/plugin exports; current terminal-ui ownership permits core.
families.consumer_implications: CLI runTui adapts transport/config/global paths into run.
families.maintenance_implications: Preserve public exports; generated README module-contract block has a separate owner.
families.semantic_limits: Ancillary bun/TypeScript configuration inventoried; no package command executed.

families.purpose: Renderer lifetime, application provider composition and navigation
families.source_implications: run acquires renderer under Effect scope, wires providers and waits for shutdown; route union is home/session/plugin.

families.maintenance_implications: Maintain cleanup ordering, route validation and continue/fork hydration ordering.
families.semantic_limits: Provider wiring is inspected; not every small supporting context/component implementation is read. Mock-renderer lifecycle test is unexecuted.

families.purpose: V2 event transport, catalog mapping, hydration and client actions

families.maintenance_implications: Preserve idempotent event application and hydration coalescing; verify actual transport when changing contracts.
families.semantic_limits: Client/server internals outside boundary; no network, reconnection, or product tests executed.

families.purpose: Model/agent selection and process state persistence

families.maintenance_implications: Keep stable identity distinct from display name; preserve save ordering.
families.semantic_limits: Atomic replacement plus file locking does not prove cross-process merge semantics.

families.purpose: Prompt admission, completion, parts and project/session movement

families.semantic_limits: Part/display/trait/local-attachment leaf algorithms are family-supported by prompt call sites, not separately audited. Race test mirrors implementation and is unexecuted.

families.purpose: Local history, stash, frecency and compatibility exports

families.maintenance_implications: Preserve tolerant parsing and bounded retention; compatibility import paths remain relevant.
families.semantic_limits: Frecency ranking internals not inspected.
